title: B-N1, a protocol-card leaderboard of public VLMs on Vietnamese benchmarks (Paper B)

venv.how: a copy of the G2-B venv (/root/venv-qwen3vl) as /root/venv-lb plus num2words 0.5.14, which SmolVLMProcessor needs; nothing else in the venv changes (PD-17 J5); package versions and the pip freeze sha256 are recorded in EVENTS before queueing

model_list: frozen in the commit of this file (PD-17 J5)

decoder.rule: committed with this prereg; a run stops unless the decoder's own sha256 equals this pin, and the job checks it with every other pin (PD-17 (d))

decode.loader: AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(snapshot, trust_remote_code=False, **processor_kwargs); tokenizer.padding_side='left'; AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained(snapshot, trust_remote_code=False, attn_implementation, device_map={'': 'cuda:0'}, dtype)
decode.message: [{'role': 'user', 'content': [{'type': 'image', 'image': PIL.Image.open(path).convert('RGB')}, {'type': 'text', 'text': PROMPTS[mode]}]}], one conversation per image; processor.apply_chat_template(batch, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors='pt', padding=True), cast to the model dtype
decode.greedy: model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=n, do_sample=False, num_beams=1); every other setting from the snapshot's generation_config.json (recorded in each output)
decode.text: tokens up to and including the first EOS, decoded with skip_special_tokens=True, stripped; n_tokens and hit_max (no EOS within n) recorded per image
decode.batching: fixed slices of the manifest order of the model's registered batch size; slice 0 is also decoded at batch size 1 and the identical-caption count is recorded (no gate)
decode.checks: package versions equal venv.packages (else KD); every pinned snapshot file hashes to its pin; the set manifest hashes to its pin; each image hashes to its manifest row
decode.prompt_source: scripts/evaluate.py PROMPTS (texts read and sha-checked by the decoder)

tau0.why: IR convention for equivalent system rankings (Voorhees, SIGIR 2001; Buckley & Voorhees, SIGIR 2004 use it for incomplete judgments); chosen before any LB output; citation to be checked in bib v4 (A-N6)

n_boot.quote: B = 1000, draws shared within an image set

design_constants.bootstrap: 1000 image-bootstrap draws per analysis set: numpy.random.default_rng(0).multinomial(N, [1/N]*N, size=1000) over the set's images in id order, shared by every system, gold and family of the analysis (paired). 95% CI = percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 of the replicates.

status_rules.D-W13-6: REGISTERED only if the commit of this file precedes the first output of any run listed here; LOCALLY_FROZEN (sha-matching file on disk before, commit after) is EXPLORATORY in claims with the times disclosed; POST_HOC if written at or after an output; EXPLORATORY without a prereg.

cost.anchor: .session_backup/2026-10-18/gpu_jobs/GPU_JOB_PLAN_v1.md line '56_multiref_s42': eval of KTVIC test, short + detailed, Qwen2.5-VL-7B = 0.7 h -> 2.26 s per caption (batch-1 harness, upper bound); models <= 5B params at half that (planning assumption)

split.rule: leaked = a KTVIC test image with a matched copy in the UIT-OpenViIC TRAIN split (data/ktvic_openviic_refs.json _pairs.test, split field; ids only); clean = the rest
split.commit: the two ID-only lists and their provenance file are committed with this prereg (PD-17 J6)

inclusion_rule: a public VLM enters B-N1 if its card lists 'vi', or the card of its language model names Vietnamese or claims >= 100 languages (fixed before any output); sources in models.*.vietnamese_source

replacement_rule.rule: PD-17 J5, written before any decode and applied at drafting time: a candidate replaces Gemma-3 only if it is ungated, HF-native (no remote code; its class ships with transformers 4.57.6), Vietnamese documented (the inclusion rule), pinned to a revision with per-file hashes, and its licence is recorded; candidates are the fixed list of the LB brief and the gap analysis, checked in order
replacement_rule.result: no candidate qualifies, so B-N1 runs with 4 models and the 4-model tau0 applies

reference_rows.what: our fine-tuned systems, existing outputs: reference rows only; they enter no verdict and no tau (PD-17 (c))

scoring.cider: scripts/evaluate.py (committed protocol-card scorer): RDRSegmenter word level, CIDEr-D x100 (rescap.metrics.CaptionMetrics), NCS_DATASET in {ktvic, uitviic}, predictions as {image_id: caption}; the segmenter name it records must not be a whitespace fallback
scoring.fix: the punctuation fix: strip trailing whitespace and the characters . ! ? ... (U+2026) from the end of every candidate AND every reference before segmentation (Paper B Section 3.3, 'final period stripped'), then the same scorer; as written = the committed scorer unchanged
scoring.per_image: per-image CIDEr-D from one scorer call per set, system and variant (IDF from the full set's references); bootstrap replicates are means of per-image scores over the shared draws
scoring.objects: object P/R/F1 as scripts/object_prf.py's KTVIC convention (unique classes, reference-derived gold, exact matches): matcher v1 = rescap.chair.objects_in with RESCAP_RAW_TONE=1, v2 = the tone-normalised default; both sets
scoring.sets_for_verdicts: LBB-P1 and LBB-P2 use the FULL KTVIC test set (558 images); both are also reported on the clean 157 as a sensitivity analysis that changes no verdict, because the models' training data is unknown (PD-17 (b))
scoring.language_guard: share of captions failing rescap.vlm.mock.looks_vietnamese or matching CJK_RE, per run; verdicts use full sets (evaluate.py refuses subset scoring); clean-intersection values are a sensitivity analysis
scoring.evaluator: written after this registration, committed through the gatekeeper before any output is scored

verdict_rules.sign_gt_0: PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.compound: FAIL if any part is FAIL; else NOT_EVALUABLE if any part is NOT_EVALUABLE; else PASS if every part is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.counting: Kill rules count FAIL only. INCONCLUSIVE is reported as inconclusive and never as support. Earlier preregistrations scored sign and ordering claims on point estimates; 'not FAIL' here is that criterion, so the outcomes can be compared.
verdict_rules.multiplicity: No correction; every prediction is reported separately, per dataset, with its CI.
verdict_rules.tau_lt: PASS if ci95_hi < tau0; FAIL if point >= tau0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.tau_ge: PASS if ci95_lo >= tau0; FAIL if point < tau0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.tau_b: Kendall tau-b between two vectors of per-model point estimates (ties handled as in tau-b); the CI comes from the same statistic on every shared bootstrap draw (both rankings recomputed on each draw)

predictions.claim: the punctuation fix changes the zero-shot CIDEr-D ranking on KTVIC test (short prompt)
predictions.rule: `tau_b(CIDEr_as_written(ZS), CIDEr_fix(ZS))` on the full KTVIC test set, tau_lt (tau0 1: at least 1 discordant pair of 6 (no ties)); ZS = the B-N1 zero-shot models
predictions.source: Paper B Section 3.3 (KTVIC references carry no final period)

predictions.claim: under the fix, KTVIC test and UIT-ViIC test rank the zero-shot systems equivalently (short prompt)
predictions.rule: `tau_b(CIDEr_fix(ZS) on the full ktvic_test, CIDEr_fix(ZS) on uitviic_test)` tau_ge (tau0 0.6: at most 1 discordant pair of 6 (no ties))
predictions.why_tau0: departs from the 0.9 convention cited for LBA-P1: with n = 4 (or 5) one discordant pair is the smallest possible disagreement, so tau0 lets exactly one swapped pair count as agreement (PD-17 J7); the bootstrap-CI rule stays, and with so few systems INCONCLUSIVE is a likely and honest outcome

predictions.rule: `tau_b(fix) - tau_b(as written)` (the LBB-P2 statistic minus its as-written twin) sign_gt_0

predictions.claim: leaked minus clean gap per model and reference row: CIDEr-D (both variants), object F1 (v1, v2)
predictions.rule: reported with CIs from bootstrap draws within each part, no verdict

predictions.claim: LBB-P1 and LBB-P2 recomputed on the clean 157 KTVIC test images
predictions.rule: reported with CIs; changes no verdict (the models' training data is unknown)

predictions.claim: the leaderboard: CIDEr-D (both variants), BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, object P/R/F1 (v1, v2), end-punctuation rate, length, language-guard share, hit_max share, parity, both prompts
predictions.rule: reported, no verdict; reference rows shown beside, outside every tau

kill_rules.then: Paper B does not claim that the fix re-ranks public zero-shot systems; it reports the shifts only
Paper B does not claim that KTVIC rankings transfer to UIT-ViIC; it reports the discordant pairs

kill_rules.when: a model has a run missing or excluded by KD on a set
kill_rules.then: the model leaves every tau on that set; a tau with fewer than 4 models is NOT_EVALUABLE

kill_rules.when: a run whose provenance differs from this registration (model file, prompt, decoding, batch size, package version)
kill_rules.then: the run does not test this registration

reporting: Every verdict is quoted as computed, with the protocol card (segmenter, CIDEr-D, x100, punctuation variant).
Exposure labels: KTVIC leaked/clean by OpenViIC train copy; UIT-ViIC test = COCO train2014 images. The training data of the public models are not verified by this registration.
B-N1 belongs to Paper B, and its claims follow KB1 and KB2 (PD-17 (e)); Paper A cites none of its numbers.

PD-6 (c) note for Paper B: Paper A's G2-B uses the same model (Qwen3-VL-8B) on the same UIT-ViIC test images (UV231) with a different statistic (verbosity slopes under gold levels), so no number is primary in both papers.
overlap: UIT-ViIC test images are also Paper A images (G2-B in Vietnamese; A-N2 in English). B-N1 decodes its own Qwen3-VL runs; they use the same prompts, new-token limits and pixel bounds as G2-B's *-short-T0 and *-detailed-T0 UV231 runs, at another batch size, and no G2-B output is read (PD-17 J3).
XM600 is dropped: XM3600 belongs to Paper A (PD-6; PD-17 J3).
departures: XM3600-vi (gap analysis B-N1) is dropped (PD-17 J3).
Gemma-3-4b-it is dropped (gated: no tokens or credentials on rented machines, PD-17 J5); the replacement rule found no qualifying model, so B-N1 has 4 models.
Vintern-1B-v3.5 is left out for scope: one HF-native decoder for every model, so that every model runs through the same audited code path (PD-17 J4). Vistral-V-7B is not HF-native and is gated.
LLaVA-OneVision-7B, LLaVA-1.5-7B, Idefics3-8B and SmolVLM2-2.2B fail the inclusion rule.
Qwen2.5-VL-7B is decoded again with this harness; the existing zero-shot outputs (older harness) stay Paper B's backbone baseline, and their exact-match share with the new decodes is reported.
